text: NEW YORK, July 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Gainey McKenna & Egleston announces that a securities class action lawsuit has been filed in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York on behalf of all persons or entities who purchased or otherwise acquired Rackspace Technology, Inc. (“Rackspace” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: RXT) securities between May 7, 2026 and July 8, 2026, inclusive (the “Class Period”).
title: Gainey McKenna & Egleston Announces A Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Rackspace Technology, Inc. (RXT)
